directions.title: FACT round-37 #6 — CHEBOTAREV-PRECISION: the master table reproduces simultaneously, max deviation 0.00048 bits (paper 134)
directions.description:
Round-37 #6 (exp 463, assessment v243). First simultaneous re-measurement of the ENTIRE type-channel master table — 15 canonical fields, one protocol, one seed, 295,946 unramified primes/field < 2^22, law values computed fresh from explicit permutation groups.

**H0 — PRECISION HOLDS**: global max |I_meas − I_law| = **0.00048 bits**, 20x inside the pre-stated 0.01 budget. No flags.

- Every recorded headline reproduced within max(0.01, 3σ).
- The one anomaly diagnosed: S3d's historical 1.0078 vs exact law 1.0000 (simultaneous remeasurement 0.9998±0.001) = small-population plug-in bias on the sparse 229-class dial — not physics, not dictionary drift.
- Fresh law constants matched hand-derived values to 6 decimals on all 10 groups (incl. D4 = 1.655639, A4 = 0.918296).
- Controls: thickening −0.00044; coprime flatness below null bias floor on six fields; sympy ground truth 0 mismatches ×15 fields; abelian dictionaries 100%.

The lab's ~128-paper measurement record is internally consistent to 5e-4 bits — extending the reproducibility-audit line (papers 97/103) from stored-seed re-runs to cross-field simultaneous measurement.

Ledger: 7 catches, ALL before results (D4 generator → S4 closure exposed by hand constants; F20 seeded as C5; LSB/MSB exponent mismatch; q²|disc ramified test; ...).

Repro: ResearchOutput/scripts/2026-08-21-resume/exp463_precision.py + exp463_result.json + exp463_full_run.log, seed 20260821.
